coverage.why: All seven accounting areas and the industry lens carry a finding and verdict, and every financial section plus DuPont and path to distress is answered. The manifest shows zero items dropped in both frames after the gate rewrites.

calibration.why: Area verdicts track their anomalies (e.g. estimates_and_reserves names the one allowance exception it lists as 'contradicts'). The one stretch: the cash_flow_engineering verdict says the receivables-sale programme lifts operating cash, while its own anomaly leaves that effect unmeasured.

valuation_reading.why: With market.missing and implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing, it cannot say where the price sits or what growth it implies. valuation.missing leaves no sensitivity grid, so its two assumptions are chosen against history, not from the calculator. It reports all three gaps honestly.
